---
execute:
  echo: fenced
  eval: false
  output: asis
  daemon: 30
  cache: refresh
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    number-sections: false
    df-print: kable
    theme: cosmo
---

Every nested value here renders exit 0 under `quarto render` 1.7.33, so the feature
must produce ZERO diagnostics: `execute.echo: fenced` (valid enum member),
`execute.eval: false` (valid boolean), `execute.output: asis` (OPEN, valid),
`execute.daemon: 30` (OPEN number), `execute.cache: refresh` (valid enum member),
`format.html.toc: true` / `format.html.number-sections: false` (valid booleans),
`format.html.df-print: kable` (valid enum member), `format.html.theme: cosmo` (OPEN
free string).
